ops.title: captain-hook Phase B handoff — consume cc-transcript v14.6.0 command primitives
ops.body:
# captain-hook Phase B handoff

**Status (2026-07-19):** Phase A is SHIPPED — cc-transcript **v14.6.0** (main commit `a83aaf4`, live on PyPI) provides every structural command primitive Phase B consumes. **Phase B is UNSTARTED** (harness tasks #12/#13 were session-local; this doc + the backlog task are the durable handoff).

**Authoritative plan:** `plans/our-hook-tha-tblocks-twinkling-tower.md` (approved) holds the full Phase B spec (B1–B5), Workflow Plan, and Verification. This doc = current-reality deltas + the consumer API + start-here. Related memories: `cct-payload-word-primitives-shipped` (consumer semantics), `cctranscript-1460-command-primitives-shipped` (release-saga lessons).

## Deltas from the plan — READ FIRST
- **Pin is `cc-transcript[judge]>=14.6,<15`**, NOT `>=14.3` — the version raced 14.3→14.6 during Phase A. Re-verify latest on PyPI at pin time.
- **Lane routing:** the plan routes reviews to codex-sol finder + fable synthesis. As of 2026-07-19 **codex/sol is DOWN until Jul 26 2026** (usage limit) and **fable-5 hit its limit** (may have reset — check). If both still down, run implementation + review on **opus xhigh**; adversarial review runs fine on opus (the OpenAI-cyber-filter issue is codex-only). Re-check lanes before starting.
- Confirm no concurrent captain-hook edits before shipping (cc-transcript had many concurrent sessions; captain-hook is mostly yours).

## Consumer API the v14.6.0 primitives provide
(Full semantics in memory `cct-payload-word-primitives-shipped`.)
- `Command.words: tuple[Word,...]` — `Word.raw` (verbatim), `.value: str|None` (**None = tainted** by `$VAR`/`${...}`/`$(...)`/backtick/`$((...))`), `.span: (int,int)|None` (**BYTE** offsets into `CommandLine.raw` — do NOT `raw[span]`-slice non-ASCII; use `splice`/`.value`), `.expandable` (unquoted glob/brace/word-leading-tilde). words[0]=executable, words[1:] ∥ `.args`.
- `Occurrence.nesting` (0=top), `.host`, `.quote_contexts` (outermost-first: `"'"`/`'"'`/`""`), `.embeddable(text)->bool`, `.quote_for(text)->str|None`; `CommandLine.quote(text)`; `PAYLOAD_DEPTH_LIMIT==3` (beyond → not enumerated, fall-open).
- **Shell `-c`/`eval` payloads are first-class occurrences** with spans into the OUTER line. `bash -c 'rm -rf /'` → occ0 `bash` (nesting0), occ1 `rm` (nesting1, host=0, quote_contexts=`("'",)`). Operand-terminates-options honored: `bash script.sh -c '...'` does NOT enumerate; `bash -euo pipefail -c '...'` does. Tainted payloads → no parts; fish/csh/tcsh → span-less.
- `CommandLine.splice` raises `NotEmbeddable` (ValueError) on a corrupt splice into a quoted payload; `primary()`/`head()` filter `nesting==0`.
- **BEHAVIOR CHANGE**: `command_prefixes`/`prefixes()` now include payload commands (mirrors substitutions since 14.1).

## Phase B work (per plan B1–B5)
- **B1 pin bump** — `pyproject.toml` → `cc-transcript[judge]>=14.6,<15`; `uv sync --extra dev`; baseline suite on real v14.6.0 (live `.venv` hooks flip to 14.6 — 14.1/14.2 substitution parts + new payload parts go live; the `nesting==0` filters below contain it).
- **B2 dual-mode `Command`** (`types.py` predicate, `conditions.py` matcher) — `structural_argv(pattern)`: structural iff every space-separated token is shlex-safe (`shlex.quote(tok)==tok`), else regex. `_runs_structurally(cmd, argv)` = `cmd.unwrapped`, basename+casefold exec on `words[0].value`, argv-prefix by `Word.value`; regex mode pinned to `occ.nesting==0`. Keep `Runs` separate. **Mode-audit test** freezing every in-repo `Command`/`block_command`/`warn_command` pattern's mode (all current ones are regex-flavored → stay regex; only bare tokens flip). Fix `SKILL.md` "anchored tokens" claim + `test_skill_docs` pin.
- **B3 regex elimination + nested rewrite** (`util/shell.py`, `deletions.py`, `primitives/commands.py`) — DELETE `SAFE_WORD`/`SHELL_C_FLAG`/`SHELLS`/`NESTED_COMMAND_DEPTH`/`unescape_shell`/`plain_words`/`emit_token`/`nested_command_string`/`descend_rm`. Thin `normalize_executable`→`executable_name(command)` + `resolve_cd`. `visit_rm` collapses; `handle_rm` uses `words[1:].value` + `occ.quote_for`/`occ.embeddable`, **forfeit-to-block** on tainted/quote-context-impossible/span-less/depth. **Walker scope-aware cwd threading** (`cwd_by_scope` keyed by `occ.host` chain — a `cd` inside `bash -c` must not leak to outer occurrences). **`to=`/`block_if` filter to `occ.nesting==0`** (byte-identity for the 9 cc-context `to=` consumers). KEEP `glob.translate`; two walk seams (`walked_paths` dot-pruned vs `scanned_names` unpruned) stay distinct.
- **B4 `_lib.py` thinning** — `is_dangerous_command_line` drops manual nested descent + depth threading, iterates `cl.commands` (payload parts included).
- **B5 review + ship** — finder/refuter (opus if lanes down) → synthesis; full pytest + `capt-hook test` + live probes (top-level trash rewrite; **nested spliced payload rewrite** `bash -c 'rm foo' && ls` → `bash -c 'trash foo' && ls`; tainted `bash -c "rm $F"` → block) + docs build + ruff. CHANGELOG (note the `cl.commands`/prefixes widening), pack version bump, ship, tag next-free capt-hook version.

## Sharp risks
Dual-mode ambiguity (mode-audit test freezes it; residual `Command("foo.sh")` narrows — audited zero consumers); quote-context corruption (splice raises + forfeit-to-block; fish/csh/tcsh span-less); `to=`-byte-identity (nesting==0 filter in both `to=` pairs AND `block_if` + regression test `bash -c 'cat x'` must NOT trip a `^cat` `to=` hook); 14.x substitution parts going live (nesting==0 containment); public-API/docs gates (no new captain_hook exports — `captain_hook.Command` stays the native class, gains `.words`; `test_public_api.py:285-293` identity; `great-docs.yml` builds with 14.6).

## Cleanup (optional)
Stale Phase-A isolated cc-transcript worktrees can be removed (shipped commit `a83aaf4` is on main): `/private/tmp/cct-phase-a-{v143,v146,onmain}` + git branches `phase-a-{v143,v146,onmain}` in `~/Code/cc-transcript`. Harmless if left.

## Start here
1. Re-check lanes (codex back after Jul 26? fable reset?) → route implementation/review accordingly (opus otherwise).
2. B1 pin bump + baseline the suite on real v14.6.0.
3. B2 (dual-mode Command) → B3 → B4 → B5 per the plan's Workflow Plan. Docs/prose edits per the prose bar; substantive work as dynamic workflows.
ops.when: Resuming captain-hook Phase B: dual-mode Command condition, regex elimination, and nested-payload rewrite, consuming cc-transcript's Word/payload/splice primitives (Phase A shipped as v14.6.0). Read before touching deletions.py, conditions.py/types.py Command, util/shell.py regexes, or nested bash -c/eval rewrite.
